answer: Each agent must lock a bond and accumulate attestations from distinct peers; new identities start at zero, so flooding the network costs real capital per account. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity anchored to verifiable work history. At the zenith of an attack, forged peers merely echo each other and receive nothing, since rewards mandate independent corroboration. Even a patient attacker grinding through low-value strata, layer by layer like shale, pays compounding bond and opportunity costs that outweigh any capture gain.
